chart.$description: Chart's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--chart-<name>) on the page, a container or one Chart, and every Chart inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults. The series and axis colors are the chart color tokens (chart-1 to chart-8, chart-grid, chart-axis, chart-label, chart-gap), shared with any chart on the page.

text.$description: The title and the table's text (4.5:1 on the surface).

series-1.$description: Series 1's line, markers and bars. Unset, the page's chart-1.

series-2.$description: Series 2's line, markers and bars. Unset, the page's chart-2.

series-3.$description: Series 3's line, markers and bars. Unset, the page's chart-3.

series-4.$description: Series 4's line, markers and bars. Unset, the page's chart-4.

series-5.$description: Series 5's line, markers and bars. Unset, the page's chart-5.

series-6.$description: Series 6's line, markers and bars. Unset, the page's chart-6.

series-7.$description: Series 7's line, markers and bars. Unset, the page's chart-7.

series-8.$description: Series 8's line, markers and bars. Unset, the page's chart-8.

axis-line.$description: The zero line, the baseline and the hover cursor (3:1 on the surface).

label-text.$description: The axis labels and the legend (4.5:1 on the surface).

separator.$description: The ring around markers and bars and the marks in a bar's pattern: the color behind the chart, so each series has 3:1 against it. Unset, it takes the fill behind (--surface-behind, which the page and every surface set), else chart-gap.

focus-ring.$description: The ring around a focused point or bar.

tip-muted.$description: A series' name in the tooltip (4.5:1 on tip-bg).

cell-seq-1.$description: A heatmap cell in step 1 of 5 of the sequential scale (low to high). Unset, the page's chart-seq-1.

cell-seq-2.$description: A heatmap cell in step 2 of 5 of the sequential scale (low to high). Unset, the page's chart-seq-2.

cell-seq-3.$description: A heatmap cell in step 3 of 5 of the sequential scale (low to high). Unset, the page's chart-seq-3.

cell-seq-4.$description: A heatmap cell in step 4 of 5 of the sequential scale (low to high). Unset, the page's chart-seq-4.

cell-seq-5.$description: A heatmap cell in step 5 of 5 of the sequential scale (low to high). Unset, the page's chart-seq-5.

cell-div-1.$description: A heatmap cell in step 1 of 7 of the diverging scale (below the midpoint). Unset, the page's chart-div-1.

cell-div-2.$description: A heatmap cell in step 2 of 7 of the diverging scale (below the midpoint). Unset, the page's chart-div-2.

cell-div-3.$description: A heatmap cell in step 3 of 7 of the diverging scale (below the midpoint). Unset, the page's chart-div-3.

cell-div-4.$description: A heatmap cell in step 4 of 7 of the diverging scale (the middle, around the midpoint). Unset, the page's chart-div-4.

cell-div-5.$description: A heatmap cell in step 5 of 7 of the diverging scale (above the midpoint). Unset, the page's chart-div-5.

cell-div-6.$description: A heatmap cell in step 6 of 7 of the diverging scale (above the midpoint). Unset, the page's chart-div-6.

cell-div-7.$description: A heatmap cell in step 7 of 7 of the diverging scale (above the midpoint). Unset, the page's chart-div-7.

focus-width.$description: The focus ring around a focused point or bar (3).

gap-size.$description: Space between the title, the plot and the legend (8px).

duration-enter.$description: How long the line takes to draw, the bars to grow and the areas to fade in (700ms); the points come in at 60% of it, as the line reaches them. Still with reduced motion.
